name: B-But We're Both Alphas?!
source:
Yuel Malek is in a state. As an alpha, Yuel is supposed to be on the top of the proverbial food chain, but this couldn't be further from the truth.

Yuel might be an alpha, but he isn't a stereotypical one. He's anxious and self-conscious, not full of swagger, and he often finds himself overwhelmed by his ruts. Afraid of his own sexuality, and worried of forcing his desires onto other people, Yuel retreats from society, and he even considers dropping out of university.

When in the midst of an especially bad rut, Yuel decides to turn to his older cousin, Tavi, for help. Like him, Tavi is an alpha, and Yuel is hoping Tavi can help him excise his urges.

Yuel [i]thinks[/i] that Tavi is an alpha, at least... but when Yuel experiences an inexplicable attraction for his older cousin, he begins to wonder.

[From [url=https://ebihime.itch.io/but-were-both-alphas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤埃尔·马利克现在处于一种状态。作为阿尔法，尤尔应该处于众所周知的食物链的顶端，但这与事实相去甚远。

尤尔可能是一名阿尔法，但他并不是一个典型的阿尔法。他很焦虑，很不自在，并不趾高气扬，而且经常发现自己被自己的陈规所压垮。由于害怕自己的性取向，并担心将自己的欲望强加给别人，尤埃尔从社会中退缩，甚至考虑从大学退学。

当尤尔陷入特别糟糕的生活状态时，他决定向他的表兄塔维寻求帮助。和他一样，塔维也是阿尔法，尤尔希望塔维能帮助他消除自己的冲动。

尤尔[i]认为[/i]塔维至少是一个阿尔法……但当尤尔对他的表弟产生一种莫名其妙的吸引力时，他开始怀疑。

[来自[url=https://ebihime.itch.io/but-were-both-alphas]itch.io[/url]]
